# Legal Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the Legal department in the whole system: how well legal review, contracts, privacy, compliance, and intellectual property hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Legal review and contracts
- Privacy and data handling
- Compliance basics
- Intellectual property and licenses
- Record of obligations and renewal dates

## What is in place
- [ ] Lead agent for legal is named and active
- [ ] Skill that reviews contracts and terms
- [ ] Skill that checks privacy handling
- [ ] Skill that checks license and compliance basics
- [ ] Workflow that reviews new commitments before they are signed
- [ ] Record of contracts, licenses, and obligations in one place

## Gaps
- [ ] Contracts are signed without review
- [ ] Privacy handling is undocumented
- [ ] License obligations are unclear
- [ ] Compliance gaps are not tracked
- [ ] Obligations and renewal dates live in scattered notes

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real contract review and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
